info.description:
**Last updated:** May 2026

Disposable email infrastructure for developers.

All routes require `Authorization: Bearer fce_<key>` (developer API key), except `GET /v1/plans` and `GET /v1/otp/public` which are public.

## IMAP & POP3 (Growth/Enterprise)

In addition to the HTTP API, Growth and Enterprise plans can read inboxes via standard mail protocols (TLS only):

| Protocol | Host | Port | Auth |
|----------|------|------|------|
| IMAP4rev1 | imap.freecustom.email | 993 | username = inbox address, password = fce_ key |
| POP3 | pop.freecustom.email | 995 | username = inbox address, password = fce_ key |

Connecting and listing messages are free. Fetching a message body (IMAP FETCH / POP3 RETR) costs 1 request from the monthly quota. Docs: https://freecustom.email/api/docs/imap
